Set bounds and target tolerances for peak filtering

mc_peak_parameters.Rd

Create a complete named list of peak-filter settings with selected defaults replaced.

mc_peak_parameters(...)

Arguments

...

Named settings to replace. Supported names, meanings, units, and defaults are listed below. Unknown names raise an error.

Details

Bounds have an effect only when their corresponding filter is selected. No peak filters are selected by default. Pass the returned list to mc_filter_peak(parameters = ...).

peak_filters

Peak filters enabled when mc_filter_peak(filters = NULL): "mz", "rt", "rmd", "amd" and/or "target". An empty vector selects none. An explicit filters vector overrides this setting. Default: character(0).

mz_min_enable

Enable the lower m/z limit, peak_mz_min, when the "mz" peak filter is selected. FALSE disables this bound only. Default: TRUE.

mz_max_enable

Enable the upper m/z limit, peak_mz_max, when the "mz" peak filter is selected. FALSE disables this bound only. Default: FALSE.

peak_mz_min

Lower m/z limit in m/z units. Keep values greater than or equal to this limit when mz_min_enable = TRUE and the "mz" filter is selected. Default: 200.

peak_mz_max

Upper m/z limit in m/z units. Keep values less than or equal to this limit when mz_max_enable = TRUE and the "mz" filter is selected. Default: 1500.

rt_min_enable

Enable the lower retention time limit, peak_rt_min, when the "rt" peak filter is selected. FALSE disables this bound only. Default: TRUE.

rt_max_enable

Enable the upper retention time limit, peak_rt_max, when the "rt" peak filter is selected. FALSE disables this bound only. Default: FALSE.

peak_rt_min

Lower retention time limit in minutes. Keep values greater than or equal to this limit when rt_min_enable = TRUE and the "rt" filter is selected. Default: 1.

peak_rt_max

Upper retention time limit in minutes. Keep values less than or equal to this limit when rt_max_enable = TRUE and the "rt" filter is selected. Default: 30.

rmd_min_enable

Enable the lower relative mass defect (RMD) limit, peak_rmd_min, when the "rmd" peak filter is selected. FALSE disables this bound only. Default: TRUE.

rmd_max_enable

Enable the upper relative mass defect (RMD) limit, peak_rmd_max, when the "rmd" peak filter is selected. FALSE disables this bound only. Default: TRUE.

peak_rmd_min

Lower relative mass defect (RMD) limit in ppm. Keep values greater than or equal to this limit when rmd_min_enable = TRUE and the "rmd" filter is selected. Default: -2000.

peak_rmd_max

Upper relative mass defect (RMD) limit in ppm. Keep values less than or equal to this limit when rmd_max_enable = TRUE and the "rmd" filter is selected. Default: 2000.

amd_min_enable

Enable the lower absolute mass defect (AMD) limit, peak_amd_min, when the "amd" peak filter is selected. FALSE disables this bound only. Default: TRUE.

amd_max_enable

Enable the upper absolute mass defect (AMD) limit, peak_amd_max, when the "amd" peak filter is selected. FALSE disables this bound only. Default: TRUE.

peak_amd_min

Lower absolute mass defect (AMD) limit in Da. Keep values greater than or equal to this limit when amd_min_enable = TRUE and the "amd" filter is selected. Default: 0.

peak_amd_max

Upper absolute mass defect (AMD) limit in Da. Keep values less than or equal to this limit when amd_max_enable = TRUE and the "amd" filter is selected. Default: 0.5.

target_peak_action

Action for features matching a target by both m/z and retention time: "remove" discards matches; "keep" retains only matches. Used when the "target" peak filter is selected. Default: remove.

target_mz_tol_type

Mass-tolerance unit for target matching: "da" uses target_mz_tol_da; "ppm" uses target_mz_tol_ppm. Default: da.

target_mz_tol_da

Absolute m/z tolerance in Da for matching features to targets. Used only when target_mz_tol_type = "da". Default: 0.005.

target_mz_tol_ppm

Relative m/z tolerance in ppm for matching features to targets. Used only when target_mz_tol_type = "ppm". Default: 10.

target_rt_tol

Maximum retention-time difference in minutes between a feature and a target. Both the m/z and retention-time conditions must pass for a target match. Default: 0.05.

Value

A named list containing every peak-filter parameter, including unchanged defaults.

See also

mc_filter_peak, mc_plot_peak

Examples

peak_options <- mc_peak_parameters(
  peak_filters = c("mz", "rt"),
  mz_min_enable = TRUE, peak_mz_min = 200,
  mz_max_enable = TRUE, peak_mz_max = 1500,
  rt_min_enable = TRUE, peak_rt_min = 1,
  rt_max_enable = FALSE
)
peak_options
